description: Exports image content from one or more page elements as files and optionally inline data.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the target image elements.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID from DOM.getAXTree.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector resolved in the main document and all nested author Shadow DOM trees.

items.description: DOM query target identified by id, selector, or both.

targets.description: One to 32 targets to export, preserving input order in response.data.items.

path.description: Required output directory. Every successful image item is written to this directory with an automatic filename.

format.description: Response payload format. Successful images are always written to options.path; base64/dataUrl additionally include inline data.

imageFormat.description: Preferred image encoding. auto preserves safe self-contained inline SVG, keeps supported raster sources when possible, and otherwise encodes PNG.

quality.description: Quality for lossy encodings such as JPEG or WebP.

timeout.description: Maximum batch wait time for image loading, in seconds. 0 waits until every image finishes or fails.

options.description: Required output options. path is an output directory, not a file path.

purpose.description: Describe why these image files are needed, e.g., saving product thumbnails, collecting visual assets, or preserving image evidence

items.description: Exported image records, including paths or inline data requested by the caller.

summary.description: Counts and export summary for the returned images.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.

suggested_prompt.description: Action-specific next-step guidance based on the returned result.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Action-specific public details; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
